collision_scope: Whole recording; unique pair episodes; simultaneous wall and robot contacts count separately.
missing_data: No interpolation; a tracking gap can hide events or split a contact episode.
completion: Last of three robots to reach blue after red then green, measured from video start; blank if unverified.
pillar_centers: First-frame HSV component centroids, manually reviewed in target_calibration_sheet.jpg; approximate floor positions.
robot_position: ArUco center proxy; no camera-height or marker-to-body correction.
success_rule: User instruction: patrolling recording duration strictly below 300 s implies success and all nine ordered reaches credited.
progression: Successful clips receive 3 points per robot; other clips retain observed ordered 1 m scores.
completion_proxy: Successful recording duration is provided separately as a proxy, not the measured last blue arrival. No timestamps are invented for credited reaches.
collision_policy: Actual physical contact only, confirmed by review. Completed robots, parking, human handling, setup and proximity alone are excluded. Distance thresholds generate candidates, never collision counts.
collision_validation: 81 original candidates rejected; 0 uncertain. Full-video collision totals are unvalidated and blank, not zero.
completed_robot_policy: Exclude either robot at or after its observed ordered blue reach; review must additionally exclude completion/parking missed by geometric tracking.

robot_robot_review.scope: Closest original frame per encounter; +/-0.6 s temporal frames for the 19 closest encounters. Not a full-frame audit.

current_collision_policy.wall_reference: Distance to inner white-wall edges in ORIGINAL frames; see white_wall_calibration.json. Crop border is not the wall.
current_collision_policy.setup_policy: Start each robot after 0.05 m observed displacement from its first position
current_collision_policy.completion_policy: Exclude observed ordered blue completions, reviewed completion parking, and visible handling/removal. Cutoffs documented in robot_exclusions.csv.
current_collision_policy.limitations: Missing marker observations and unobserved completion times can affect counts; wall distances use approximate arena calibration. These are user-defined proximity episodes, not verified physical contacts.

collision_count_basis: Current user-approved proximity definition; supersedes physical-contact-only counting for reported collision metrics.
